banner.text: Fall specials are here: plan your spring garden now.

pageTitle: Fall Garden Planning | Healing Earth Design
pageDescription: Fall specials on garden consultations and planting plans, so your spring garden is designed and ready before planting season.
heading: Plan this fall, plant first thing in spring
intro: Fall is the best time to look at your garden honestly and plan what comes next. Start now and your design is finished before the nurseries fill up.

reasons.title: See the whole season
reasons.text: By fall your yard has shown you everything: where the sun fell, where water sat, and which plants thrived or struggled.

reasons.title: Time to design well
reasons.text: Winter gives us room to work through plant choices and drawings carefully, instead of rushing in April.

reasons.title: Ready when nurseries are
reasons.text: With a finished plan and plant list, you can shop early in spring while selection is at its best.

steps.title: Garden consultation
steps.text: We walk the space while this year's results are still visible and talk through what you want next.

steps.title: Planting plan or design
steps.text: I prepare your planting plan or detailed design, with a plant list and quantities.

steps.title: Shop and plant
steps.text: Use the plan on your own, or bring me along for plant shopping and installation help.
